task: Three-class pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein segmentation
training_sampling: One PA-centred patch and one PV-centred patch per patient per epoch.
loss: 0.5 weighted cross entropy + 0.5 foreground soft Dice
validation_method: Deterministic class-centred patches. Separate per-patient PA and PV patch Dice, then macro-average across patients. Not full-volume evaluation.
